import z3

# Create a 7x7 grid of integer variables
X = [[z3.Int(f'x_{i}_{j}') for j in range(7)] for i in range(7)]

# Solver
s = z3.Solver()

# Each cell between 0 and 6
for i in range(7):
    for j in range(7):
        s.add(X[i][j] >= 0, X[i][j] <= 6)

# Idempotent: x[i][i] == i
for i in range(7):
    s.add(X[i][i] == i)

# Latin square: each row and column is permutation of 0..6
for i in range(7):
    s.add(z3.Distinct([X[i][j] for j in range(7)]))
    s.add(z3.Distinct([X[j][i] for j in range(7)]))

# QG3: x[ x[i][j] ][ x[j][i] ] == i for all i,j
for i in range(7):
    for j in range(7):
        # x[ x[i][j] ][ x[j][i] ] == i
        s.add(X[ X[i][j] ][ X[j][i] ] == i)

# Check satisfiability
result = s.check()
print(result)

if result == z3.sat:
    m = s.model()
    grid = [[m.evaluate(X[i][j]).as_long() for j in range(7)] for i in range(7)]
    flat = [grid[i][j] for i in range(7) for j in range(7)]
    print(flat)
else:
    print("UNSAT")
